unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision cuts 'far too much confidence in herself', 'With some reluctance she abandoned the interesting part', and later 'Her usual self-confidence deserted her'. The surviving line sets 'warnings' against 'his arguments' but never says she gives up her planned role and adopts the V.A.D. story.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'For the first time Tuppence felt afraid' and 'She had not feared Whittington' still imply a reversal, and the interview shows her using Carter's lines.

evidence.quote:
Mr. Carter’s warnings passed
unheeded. The young lady had far too much confidence in herself to pay
any heed to them.
Mr. Carter's warnings passed unheeded, but she had too much common sense not to recognize the force of his arguments.
With some reluctance she abandoned the interesting part she had sketched out for herself.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore 'for she had far too much confidence in herself to heed them' and 'With some reluctance she abandoned the part she had sketched out', and reinsert 'Her usual self-confidence deserted her.' after V6.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: required (essential: 'She ignores the danger but takes the advice'; V6 tonal turn)
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The chill at Rita's door loses its comic and dramatic setup, since confidence never stated cannot desert her. The plan's 'ignores the danger but takes the advice' is left implicit, and 'his arguments' could be misread as referring to the danger.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Tuppence's overconfidence arc and her decision to take Carter's advice are blurred

unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: Rita's immediate offer of '£50--£60--whatever you want' implies acceptance.

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The source sets her dazzling figure, gown and 'almost ethereal beauty' against 'something hard and menacing'. The first draft cut the figure and gown, and the revision also cut the hair. In the revision, 'And yet' now directly follows the already-menacing boring eyes.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'the beauty she undeniably possessed' appears two sentences earlier.

evidence.quote: swaying grace, and the almost ethereal beauty of her face, you felt
seemed to possess a faculty of boring into the very soul of the person she was looking at. And yet, despite her swaying grace, you felt instinctively the presence of something hard and menacing
Her pale gold hair was coiled low on her neck.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore 'and the almost ethereal beauty of her face' after 'swaying grace', or the gown sentence before 'And yet'.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: required (essential: hardened beauty, boring eyes, metallic menace)
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The beauty-versus-metal contrast that defines Rita's menace is reduced. The connective reads as illogical, setting menace against menace.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Rita's portrait turns on 'And yet' without the beauty it contrasts

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The source moves from 'did not surprise her' to 'rather surprised' to 'still no word or message from Tommy' the next morning. The first draft kept all three. The revision keeps only a neutral 'Tommy had not returned' and drops the morning beat.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'Tommy might have wired, or something. I wonder where he is.' survives.
